description: Release/status rollup with commit hashes, shipped scopes, and artifact or version metadata. Topic: rein-v0-21-0-codecomplete.

evidence.content:
rein v0.21.0 **code complete / pre-tag** (2026-04-20)。用户决定 `git tag v0.21.0 && gh release create` 前独立跑 Codex CLI audit，所以 HEAD=`91390c8` 停在 release-ready 状态，暂未打 tag。

## 交付 summary (A1 Operation Registry)

从 Phase 0 到 Phase 3 用 **2 日历日（2026-04-19 → 2026-04-20）**推完：

| Phase | Ops | 里程碑 |
|-------|-----|--------|
| 0a+0b | — | 2-crate workspace + `#[op]` macro + trybuild |
| 1 | 2 | stats/health 两端 parity 打通 |
| 2.1 | 3 | diagnostics (stats/health/doctor/config/adaptive_status) |
| 2.2 | 2 | session + H5 body-JSON + H3 auth framework |
| 2.3 | 11 | maintenance 批 + dry_run runtime 信号 + 7 audit findings |
| 2.4 | 1 | feedback + 事务写纪律建立 (F2) |
| 2.5 | 9 | memory 批 + path-template framework T1-T5 + 12 audit findings |
| 2.6 | 10 | knowledge (memoir) + 2 real + 1 deferred audit findings |
| 3 | — | registry 删除 / ReinServer 瘦身 / `IntoJson::to_raw_response` framework 扩展 / F3 memoir_refine tx / v0.21.0 bump / M1+2NIT audit fixes |

合计 **38 ops + 6 轮 Codex audit + 30 findings 全闭环 (0 HIGH carried forward) + 5 phase devlog**。

## 关键不变量（v0.22 开发要沿用）

1. **`OpsRuntime` 只带 5 信号**：surface / config / dry_run / compact / exit_code。新 op 如需 per-call/per-surface 信号，抽成 runtime signal，**不**堆 global state
2. **所有 RMW 写必须 BEGIN IMMEDIATE + IIFE + COMMIT/ROLLBACK**（4 处已实现：feedback / update / memoir_link / memoir_refine）
   - **Phase 3 audit M1 未完全 backport**：只 memoir_refine 包了 COMMIT 失败 rollback，其他 3 处仍用 `execute_batch("COMMIT")?` 裸写法。v0.21.0.1 / v0.22 开头 backport 候选
3. **Codex audit per phase 是强制**，不是可选。6 轮 audit 抓到 30 finding，self-review 会漏
4. **Framework 改动单独 commit** 不跟 op migration 混
5. **Spec Q 决定在实现时 close**，不在 spec 时。path-template Q1 option A / Q2 v0.22+ deferred
6. **Doc-comment drift 是独立 audit vector** —— 删东西时 grep 引用该东西的 doc
7. **`#[tool]` scaffolding 彻底没了**，新 MCP tool 只能 `#[op(... mcp(name))]`；`mcp_registry_completeness` 测试强制这点
8. **REST response 默认 `application/json`**，但 op output 可以 override `IntoJson::to_raw_response()` 返 `(content_type, bytes)` 走非 JSON body（memoir_export ascii/dot → text/plain 是唯一现有用例）

## 状态快照

- `Cargo.toml`: v0.21.0 / `cargo build --release` 干净 (3m20s)
- 625 tests / 0 clippy warnings / doctor green
- `ops/registry.rs` 已删（-431 行），drift check 改纯 `source scan + inventory iter`
- `ReinServer` 字段只剩 `config`（-123 行 scaffolding）
- `#[tool_router]` 空架子删除，`mcp/server.rs` 380+ 行清爽
- 31 MCP tools / 35 REST routes (33 inventory + 2 legacy derived) / 35 CLI ops

## 下一步

**用户 exit Claude Code 后：**
1. 用 Codex CLI 独立跑 audit（不依赖 codex-rescue agent），可能发现 Claude 这边 self-audit missed 的问题
2. 如 audit 干净 → `cd source/rein && git tag v0.21.0 && gh release create v0.21.0 target/release/rein --title "rein v0.21.0 — A1 Operation Registry" --notes-file docs/devlog/v0.21.0-release-notes.md`
3. 如发现新问题 → 在 `91390c8` 之上 fix → 再 tag

**v0.22 候选主题**（A1 完工后 unblock）：
- 算法 #5 + #18（dedup 表层→事实层 / feedback 隐式→显式）
- scheduling-recall P1（3 路并行 + 可取消）
- B1 / B2 / C1 / C5 重评（v0.21 deferred）

## 参考文件

- 全部 phase devlog: `docs/devlog/2026-04-19-A1-phase-*` + `2026-04-20-A1-phase-*`
- A1 spec (implemented): `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-18-A1-operation-registry-codegen-design.md`
- path-template spec (Q1 closed / Q2 deferred): `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-20-A1-path-template-design.md`
- 范围决定: `docs/decisions/v0.21-scope-decision.md`
- release notes draft: `docs/devlog/v0.21.0-release-notes.md`
- roadmap: `docs/roadmap.md` (already marked "v0.21.0 代码完工 / 待 tag + release")
- backlog: `docs/backlog/architecture.md` (Phase 3 marked ✅)

evidence.content:
v0.21.0 released 2026-04-20. Tag + binary on GitHub: https://github.com/example/rein/releases/tag/v0.21.0

## Headline

A1 operation registry landed. 38 ops migrated behind `#[op]` proc-macro (single-source CLI/MCP/REST). Three rounds of audit hardening closed all known correctness issues.

## Shipped in this release

- A1: `#[op]` proc-macro + `inventory` dispatch. CLI + MCP (31 tools) + REST (21 endpoints) generated from one method on `OpsRuntime`. `ops/registry.rs` deleted; drift check runs pure source+inventory.
- AuthPolicy middleware via inventory. OpsErrorKind → HTTP status. Path-template framework for single-segment URL routing (`/api/memories/{id}`).
- H5 body-JSON framework for POST payload deserialization.
- `IntoJson::to_raw_response` hook lets ops return non-JSON content-types (e.g. memoir_export ascii/dot → text/plain).
- 7 round-3 hardening patches: schema.rs migration trigger + PRAGMA safety, sqlite.rs keep-tail MergeInto, recall.rs (1-α) KG boost scaling + M5 pre-take Cold filter, rest.rs request_id propagation, ops/adaptive.rs M2 prefix-safe access cursor + atomic offsets, rein-macros compile-fail fail-open guard.
- 6 new regression tests added (639 passing, was 633).

## Ship verification

- cargo test --workspace: 639 passed / 2 ignored
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings: clean
- trybuild: 17/17 UI cases pass
- GitHub Actions CI: both check (clippy+test) and audit (cargo audit) jobs green
- commit: 1890bb4 on master, tag v0.21.0 pushed to origin
- Working-tree cleanup: `cargo clean` removed 17.1 GiB / 31167 files; gui/node_modules removed

## Codex review loop (3 rounds)

- Round 1 (pre-release): flagged CC (1-α) naive scaling + M2 max() non-prefix-safe + 2 false-green tests
- Round 2 (post-fix): prefix-safety of max() still not solved, flagged interleaved-orphan case
- Round 3 (after prefix-safe rewrite): ALL CLEAN — contiguous-prefix walk is correct, test covers interleaved case, liveness acceptable (orphan bounded by cleanup_expired_events)

## What v0.21.0 feels like to develop on vs v0.20

- Adding an op: 3-5× less code (one method vs handler + registry + CLI + MCP + REST)
- Refactoring op params: edit one place, three surfaces auto-update
- Fail-open prevention: compile-time rejection (not runtime 500)
- Drift detection: zero cost, inventory iteration
- Unchanged: search correctness, dedup quality, LLM prompt work, adaptive tuning — all still pure domain complexity

## Codex review loop (3 rounds)

- Round 1 (pre-release): flagged CC (1-α) naive scaling + M2 max() non-prefix-safe + 2 false-green tests
- Round 2 (post-fix): prefix-safety of max() still not solved, flagged interleaved-orphan case
- Round 3 (after prefix-safe rewrite): ALL CLEAN — contiguous-prefix walk is correct, test covers interleaved case, liveness acceptable (orphan bounded by cleanup_expired_events)

## What v0.21.0 feels like to develop on vs v0.20

- Adding an op: 3-5× less code (one method vs handler + registry + CLI + MCP + REST)
- Refactoring op params: edit one place, three surfaces auto-update
- Fail-open prevention: compile-time rejection (not runtime 500)
- Drift detection: zero cost, inventory iteration
- Unchanged: search correctness, dedup quality, LLM prompt work, adaptive tuning — all still pure domain complexity

evidence.content:
rein v0.21.0-dev A1 Phase 2.3 maintenance batch 完工 2026-04-20，单日 18 commits（b4fe960 → bfb017d）。

范围决定（2026-04-20）：v0.21 仅推 A1 单线程到底，跳过 B1/B2/C1/C5 到 v0.22。理由：用户算法目标未实现，C5 LongMemEval 提前建 = 测未完成系统。A1 是算法工作唯一硬阻塞。详见 docs/decisions/v0.21-scope-decision.md。

Phase 2.3 交付：
- 11 个 maintenance/memory op 迁移（canonicals, evidence, gc, intelligent_merge_try, migrate, dedup, dedup_log, dedup_concepts, organize, consolidate, cleanup）到 #[op] inventory
- OpsRuntime 扩张 dry_run + compact AtomicBool（删死字段 non_store_count）
- OpsMcpEntry 带 mutating: bool 供 adapter 分派
- Registry 100% 反映真实工具面（swap rein_upgrade phantom → rein_feedback；加 set-equality 完整性测试）
- 6 条新 POST 路由 auth 403 + body cap 413 table-driven 测试

Codex rescue 审计（2026-04-20）7 findings 全闭环：N1 HIGH maybe_nudge 腐蚀 MCP JSON / H1 HIGH registry 缺 rein_feedback / M1 compact mode MCP rendering / M2 non_store_count write reset 语义 / N2 empty-scope no-match 字节精确复现 / M3 POST 路由测试矩阵 / L1 --asynchronous alias。额外验证 6 条 pre-existing HIGH concerns 全 CLEAN（auth 顺序、dry_run 传递、AtomicBool 并发隔离、block_in_place runtime、H5 body cap、MCP mutation_marker 不误用）。

A1 进度 ~50%（18/~40 op）。剩余 Phase 2.4 adaptive (0.5d) → 2.5 memory (2-3d, 需 path-template 框架) → 2.6 knowledge (1.5d) → Phase 3 cleanup (1d) → v0.21.0 release。估 5-6 天到发版。

关键教训：(1) 迁移 batch 末尾跑 codex 全面审计应成标准流程 —— agent 自己迁移时不会注意到 "11 次 MCP 调用后响应变 invalid JSON" 这种系统级 regression；(2) OpsRuntime 未来扩信号要提前抽，不要等迁完才发现丢了 compact/nudge/count 三个信号；(3) registry phantom 处理从"凑平"升级到"swap 真实"，set-equality 测试堵整类漂移漏洞。

验证：521 tests pass / clippy zero / 15+ 条新回归测试。

evidence.content:
rein v0.22.0 主体完成 (2026-04-22，从 2026-04-20 启动，3 天完成，原估 5-7 天)。

最终 commit 链 (master ahead 5, HEAD=1aa9daa, 未 push):
- 1aa9daa harden(v0.22): resolve Codex round-1 LOW findings + round-2 race clarify
- 66a8e5b feat(v0.22 D3.5): I6 gate PASS — D4 pool preserves single-user p50
- d460530 feat(v0.22 D5): F1 proven unnecessary via bench — ship plan D (0 LoC)
- 371683d feat(v0.22): D4 complete — KG pool paths + service wiring + try_get fallback
- 951a07c feat(v0.22): pool infrastructure + Vec channel pool path (D0-D4)

核心成果: SQLite ConnPool + 3-channel parallel recall (FTS/Vector/KG) + try_get 饱和 fallback。opt-out via REIN_ASYNC_P1=0。无 user-facing breaking change。

验证:
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings: 0 warnings
- cargo test --workspace --release: 659 passed (+34 from v0.21 baseline 625)
- Codex audit 2 rounds via codex:codex-rescue agent: round 1 = 0 HIGH / 0 MEDIUM / 3 LOW; round 2 = 3 LOW all fixed in 1aa9daa, 0 new findings

D6 (GC buffer_unordered) 和 D7 (adaptive tokio::join!) 跳过，audit 显示 spec 估算偏差 2-3x (40→80-120 LoC; 30→80-100 LoC)，且优化对象不在 user-facing hot path。

剩余: 用户本地 soak 1-2 小时 + Cargo.toml version bump + git tag v0.22.0 + push + gh release create。binary 已 install (rein 0.20.2 → 0.21.0，代码是 v0.22 HEAD)。
